items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Dr. Lloyd too, well he's gifted to that, you see.

ctx.x: Was Bunk a legit musician, or was he a ...

Bunk could read pretty good, you understand? He could do pretty good. He played all that job in music with us, you know. He was very good. He could improvise too, I guess. Yes, yes. He had a gift for it too. He put a lot of little extra touches, you know. Dr. Lloyd too, well he's gifted to that, you see. Like you'd be a person who'd be singing, you know. And he'd play like an obligato, you understand, in between the singing and the voice and the lead. It's really pretty, you know.
Who would you say had the best tone around, if any of the guys? Best tone? Yeah.
